Nearly six billion beings died, many of them my fellow Lorrdians.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sollaw ap-Orwien]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]|<ref name="Speaking Silently">{{InsiderCite|139|Speaking Silently}}</ref>}}
The '''Kanz Disorders''' ([[3970 BBY|3970]]&ndash;[[3670 BBY]]) was a three hundred year-long conflict that took place in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Old Republic era]].

==Prelude==
The [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdans]] of the planet [[Argazda/Legends|Argazda]] in the remote [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] were believed to be the descendants of an ancient [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] colony from the [[Pre-Republic era]]. Facing constant piracy and slave raids from the alien [[Ereesi/Legends|Ereesi]] species, Argazda and its environs joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[4200 BBY]]. Due to the Kanz sector's distance from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] only reluctantly admitted the Argazdans due to their purported [[near-Human]] ancestry and the desperation of the Argazdan people.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>.

Over the decades, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] defended the Argazdans from the depredations of the Ereesi until the Argazdans developed their own military forces.<ref name="TEA" /> Despite closer ties with the Republic, the puritanical Argazdans detested Republic culture as "corrupt and faithless". During the [[Old Sith Wars]], the Argazdans came under the influence of a fundamentalist brand of [[Vianism]] known as the [[Myrialites]] who were led by Provisional [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Myrial]].<ref name="DITSPOL">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>

==The Disorders==
In [[3970 BBY]], with the Republic preoccupied with the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Myrial seceeded the Kanz sector from the Republic and renamed it the [[Argazdan Redoubt]]. In the ensuing revolution, loyalist [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdans]] were massacred while an Argazdan military fleet [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|devastated]] the Ereesi homeworld of [[Ereesus]], exterminating all life on the world.<ref name="TEA" />The Myrialites then proceeded to annex the other worlds of their sector including [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltanna]] and [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

In retaliation for the Lorrdians' support for the [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltannan]] resistance, Myrial had the Lorrdian species enslaved. The enslaved Lorrdians were forbidden by their masters from speaking with each other.<ref name="DITSPOL" /> As a result, they were forced to develop a system of subtle gestures, facial expressions, and body postures. This nonverbal form of communication would still be in use millennia later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="TEC" /><ref name="TNEC" />

The Myrialites established a totalitarian regime that would last for three hundred years.<ref name="TEC" /><ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="DITSPOL" /> Any attempt made by the Galactic Republic and the Jedi to end the disorders was cut short by the [[Mandalorian Wars]] followed by the more devastating [[Jedi Civil War|Jedi]] and [[Sith Civil War]]s.<ref name="TNEC" /> The Republic was further preoccupied by a [[G0-T0 infrastructure planning system|G0-T0]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Liberation of 400100500260026|revolt]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] in [[3946 BBY]].<ref name="TNEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>.

Towards the end of the Kanz Disorders, the last ruling [[Argazdan Regent]] [[Torphceris]] sought to maintain his power in the face of opposition from the Republic. In desperation, he betrayed his beliefs by making a pact with a demonic "[[Yuuzhan Vong|alien]]" "[[Shaper caste|artisan-shaper]]." The alien had come to the known [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and displayed much expertise in bioengineering. Torphceris used the alien's expertise to create a bioengineered monster which was buried beneath the legendary [[Slave Pits of Lorrd]]. These Slave Pits were constructed at the cost of the lives of thousands of Lorrdian slaves.<ref name="DITSPOL" />

Around [[3670 BBY]], the Lorrdian [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]] led a joint Jedi and Republic task force to liberate the Kanz sector. Despite the [[Great Galactic War]], Nora had enough support in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for military intervention. Despite dogged resistance from the Argazdans, the Jedi and Republic forces defeated the Myrialites.<ref name="DITSPOL" /> Over 500 million Lorrdians, and nearly five billion other people, were killed during the Kanz Disorders, until the Republic and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] brought the Kanz sector back under control.<ref name="Corporate Sector Sourcebook" /><ref name="TEC" /><ref name="TNEC" />

==Aftermath==
The failure of the Republic to intervene in the atrocities led the Republic government to reconsider granting membership to distant settlements and enclaves in the far reaches of the galaxy and to discourage colonization schemes within the Kanz sector. The Republic's northern frontier also retreated to [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].<ref name="TEA" />

By the time of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], most Argazdans regarded their ancestors' actions in the Kanz Disorders, especially the enslavement of the Lorrdians, as shameful. Most Lorrdians and Argazdans in the sector got on well despite the repercussions of the conflict.<ref name="DITSPOL" />
